findings.title: Model router routes escalate and fallback-complex to unavailable glm-5.3:cloud

evidence.observation: Routing policy configures escalate and fallback-complex task types to require model glm-5.3:cloud
Available models catalogue contains glm-5.2:cloud but does not contain glm-5.3:cloud

proposed_action.description: Update model router policy for escalate and fallback-complex to target glm-5.2:cloud or deploy glm-5.3:cloud to router

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents task routing errors and runtime exceptions when executing escalation and fallback paths
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: model_catalogue_drift; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.95; Risk: high; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Model installation/removal requires infrastructure planning

findings.title: Deprecated Telegram bot directory persists in repository

evidence.observation: Deprecated bot code and test suites persist under telegram-bot.DEPRECATED-2026-07-12 past deprecation date

proposed_action.description: Remove telegram-bot.DEPRECATED-2026-07-12 and its legacy tests from the repository

findings.expected_benefit: Cleans repository codebase, removes obsolete test overhead, and eliminates confusion with active bots
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: dead_code; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: low; Automation: auto_with_verification

findings.title: Working tree dirtied by uncommitted lock and runtime review artifacts

evidence.observation: Repository main branch is dirty with uncommitted lock file .evolution_cycle.lock and self-improvement state files

proposed_action.description: Update .gitignore to exclude ephemeral review locks and runtime outputs in data/self-improvement/review/

findings.expected_benefit: Maintains a clean working copy and avoids committing lock files or transient review counters
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: governance_violation; Evidence strength: strong; Confidence: 0.85; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Governance fixes require architectural review
